scope: Local synthetic stale exact-vector contention; independent of the earlier historical retrieval-tail experiment
compiler: Rust 1.99.0, opt-level 3 test profile, debug 0, default features, jobs 2
stale_changes: Replace IDs 0..16, delete IDs 16..24, insert IDs 8192..8200; writer replaces already-uncovered ID 0 once per query
writer_protocol: Preconstruct replacement; query signals writer at canonical scoring entry without waiting; measure acquisition wait and complete insert; immutable pre-query full-scan oracle checked after every sample
memory: Query-thread allocator calls and peak net requested bytes while rank_vector_snapshot runs; excludes corpus, writer allocations, output serialization, and allocator metadata/RSS
preimplementation_diagnostic: One baseline process, after explicit quiet signal and before production edits; retained separately and excluded from paired comparisons

acceptance.correctness: Every complete ordered (document ID, chunk index, canonical score bits) list equals a coherent brute-force oracle; deterministic paused-scoring writer test and delta/bitmap boundaries pass
acceptance.writer: Median per-process writer lock-wait p50 decreases at least 50% at dimensions 128 and 768
acceptance.query: Median per-process query p50 and p99 increase no more than 15% for fresh_idle and stale_idle at each dimension; concurrent query latency reported without hiding tradeoffs
acceptance.allocation: Additional stale capture remains bounded by 512 KiB bitmap plus 128 document Arcs and at most 1024 scored delta hits; no embedding or document-text copy
acceptance.limits: No production/hardware/general corpus claim; host is shared desktop, processes run serially only during explicit build/test quiet window; no tuning or automatic reruns after measurements

source_pinning: Current source SHA is filled after implementation and correctness checks, before its build and first paired sample; no acceptance/workload changes after diagnostic
